novel_features.name: Outstanding-billing rollup
novel_features.description: See everything billed but not yet paid, summed per client.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local join of invoices and billing items by unpaid status that no single Ignition GraphQL call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to answer 'who owes us money' in one read instead of paging the invoice index by hand.

novel_features.name: Proposal pipeline by status
novel_features.description: Count proposals across DRAFT, AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE, ACCEPTED, and LOST for the whole book of business.
novel_features.rationale: Requires aggregating the full proposal search index locally by status enum.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this over a raw proposal list when you want the funnel shape, not individual rows.

novel_features.name: Per-client billing summary
novel_features.description: One client's full money picture: what was proposed, invoiced, and still outstanding.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining a client's proposals, invoices, and billing items from the local mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before a client call to see their entire Ignition money state in one shot.

novel_features.name: Unbilled work finder
novel_features.description: Surface accepted proposals that do not yet have a matching invoice or billing item.
novel_features.rationale: Requires diffing accepted proposals against existing invoices locally; Ignition has no such report.
novel_features.why_it_matters: This is the direct 'invoice more efficiently' lever: it finds work you agreed to but haven't billed.

novel_features.name: Rejected-payment watch
novel_features.description: List clients with a rejected or failed payment so collections can follow up.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning per-client rejected-payment summaries across the synced client set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Read this to build a follow-up list without opening each client in the Ignition UI.

narrative.headline: A read-only, agent-native CLI for Ignition proposals, invoices, billing, clients, and payments, with a local SQLite mirror and invoicing analytics the web UI does not offer.
narrative.value_prop: Ignition (ignitionapp.com) has no public API, so agents drive it through fragile browser automation. This CLI gives the firm's agents a stable read interface over the GraphQL BFF plus local-join analytics (outstanding, pipeline, unbilled, client-billing) that answer invoicing questions in one command. It is read and draft only by design: nothing here sends email, activates a proposal, creates or charges an invoice, or mutates client state.
narrative.auth_narrative: Ignition auth is a browser session cookie plus a per-page X-CSRF-Token (from the page's csrf-token meta tag). Set IGNITION_SESSION_COOKIE and IGNITION_CSRF_TOKEN from an authenticated Ignition tab; the CSRF token is minted per page-load, so refresh it if reads start returning auth errors.

quickstart.comment: confirm the binary and config resolve before hitting the API
list invoices with only the fields that matter
see what is billed but unpaid

troubleshoots.symptom: reads return an auth or 'User does not exist in the current context' error
troubleshoots.fix: refresh IGNITION_CSRF_TOKEN from the csrf-token meta tag of a logged-in Ignition tab; the token is per-page and expires
run ignition-pp-cli sync first so the local mirror is populated, then query

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent needs to read Ignition state for the firm: listing invoices, proposals, or billing items, resolving a client's money picture, or finding unbilled work before invoicing. It is the stable alternative to browser-driving Ignition for reads.
anti_triggers: sending a proposal or invoice to a client (use Corben's send gate + safe_send, never this CLI)
activating, editing, or charging anything in Ignition (this CLI is read-only)
